title: NotebookLM is now Gemini Notebook
summary: Google rebranded NotebookLM to Gemini Notebook, integrating its AI-powered research and note-taking tool more deeply into the Gemini ecosystem while maintaining core features like Audio Overviews and source-grounded responses.
problem_solved: Helps researchers and students manage, summarize, and interact with large volumes of documents and sources efficiently using AI
why_valuable: Provides an AI-native workspace where users can upload documents and have intelligent conversations with their materials, significantly reducing research time
